facebookresearch_symbolicregression/symb.encode_float_sequences: encode a numpy array of float values into token sequences using FloatSequences with configurable precision

facebookresearch_symbolicregression/symb.convert_sympy_to_prefix: convert a SymPy expression into a prefix notation list using the SYMPY_OPERATORS mapping
